# GEOFix

> Free AI visibility audit and fix service for websites. Check if your site is cited by ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Claude, Gemini, and Bing Copilot — and get it fixed.

## What We Do
GEOFix scans your website and scores it 0–100 across 6 GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) categories: AI Citability, Brand Authority, Content Quality, Technical, Structured Data, and Platform Optimization.

We provide:
- Free instant GEO score for any website
- Free manual fix instructions for every issue found
- Auto-fix code download (fixed HTML, robots.txt, llms.txt, sitemap.xml) from $4.99

## Who It's For
Small and medium businesses, freelancers, and agencies who want their websites to appear in AI-generated answers on ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, and similar platforms.

## Pricing
- Single page fix: $4.99
- Up to 5 pages: $7.99
- Up to 10 pages: $9.99
- Up to 20 pages: $14.99
- Up to 50 pages: $19.99
